messages:
Maya: Kickoff: finalizing an MVP gating & rollout playbook for Optimize toolkit — includes adaptive batching, KV-prefix caching, quantization recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Goal: measurable savings without customer surprise.
Jordan: Love it. Let's define clear "must-pass" safety gates and separate "value" gates. Safety must be met to progress.
Sanjay: Runtime constraints: prefer Dedicated-first rollout. Need per-tenant feature flags (toolkit.v1.batch, toolkit.v1.cache, toolkit.v1.quant-recs) and per-route toggles. Also require explicit KV invalidation endpoint.
Priya: Product asks: pilot bundles A/B/C so customers can opt different mixes: A=batch+cache, B=batch+quant-recs, C=all. Consent form + short explainer required.
Lee: Ops telemetry contract (minimum fields): event names: batch_emit, batch_flush, cache_lookup, cache_insert, quant_suggestion, eval_alert; metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, token_cost_estimate, cache_hit_ratio, eval_concordance_pct, svc_errors. Tag dims: customer_id, route, model_sha, canary_id. If any tag missing, block.
Alex: Proposed MVP safety gates (hard block):
- p99 latency increase <= 12% per-route
- eval_concordance drop <= 1.5% on safety suite
- end-user error rate delta <= 0.25% over baseline
- no cache-corruption incidents in canary window
Value gates (soft):
- token_cost_est improvement >= 15% for batched traffic
- median latency for low-latency route unchanged
Promote only if all safety pass and at least one value gate met.
Jordan: Important: quant recommendations should be advisory in MVP. The recommendation engine returns score + explainers (e.g., "safe: 92% concordance expected"). Only after sustained eval results do we flip serving variant.
Sanjay: Runtime config sketch to ship with canary bundle:
```
feature_flags:
  toolkit_v1_batch: true
  toolkit_v1_cache: true
  toolkit_v1_quant_recs: true
batching:
  max_latency_ms: 8
  max_batch_size: 80
cache:
  kv_prefix_ttl_s: 240
  explicit_invalidate_api: /v1/cache/invalidate
quant_recs:
  mode: advisory
  score_threshold: 0.9
eval_alerts:
  enabled: true
  sample_rate: 1.0
```
Jordan: Canary traffic plan suggestion: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% over 10 days, with holdpoints after each step for 48h. Customer tranche: NimbusCorp (enterprise), LeafApps (mid), SparkLabs (startup).
Lee: Rollback policy: automatic rollback if eval_alert severity P1/P2 or sustained customer_error_rate > 0.5% for 3 minutes. Add hysteresis so flapping won't repeatedly toggle. Ops will add runbook entries.
Priya: Ownership: Priya to coordinate consent/legal; Alex to own eval pipeline and nightly diffs (will surface top 10 regressions with context); Jordan to draft dashboard widgets; Sanjay to implement safe-mode flags and invalidation API; Lee to wire rollback automation.
Alex: Eval hooks will include: per-prompt diffs, delta scores, and a "worst-offending prompts" list for triage. I'll set retention for eval traces = 21 days and publish weekly summary.
deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved: canary-3159 (start 2026-11-02T15:00Z).
Maya: Next steps: assemble playbook doc with gating checklist, consent template, config bundle A/B/C, dashboard wireframes, and runbook snippets. Reconvene in 4 business days.
Sanjay: 44d
Jordan: 44d will draft widgets.
Priya: Adding backlog items to pilot doc now.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll update the doc and ping the pilot customers. :rocket:
